-- Track which player has the UI open and which mat they're editing
matChooserState = {
    playerColor = nil,  -- Which player has the UI open
    matGUID = nil       -- GUID of the mat being edited
}

function onLoad()
    -- Register the textures for the UI
    local assets = {}
    for i, data in ipairs(MAT_IMAGES) do
        -- Use thumb if available, otherwise fallback to full url
        local imgUrl = data.thumb or data.url
        table.insert(assets, {
            name = "Mat_Thumb_" .. i,
            url = imgUrl
        })
    end
    UI.setCustomAssets(assets)

    -- Ensure UI starts hidden
    Wait.frames(function()
        UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "false")
    end, 1)
end

-- Called by mat objects to open the chooser UI
function openMatChooser(params)
    local playerColor = params.playerColor
    local matGUID = params.matGUID
    
    -- Store state
    matChooserState.playerColor = playerColor
    matChooserState.matGUID = matGUID
    
    -- Show UI to this player only
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "visibility", playerColor)
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "true")
end

-- Called when close button is clicked
function closeMatChooser(player, value, id)
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "false")
    matChooserState.playerColor = nil
    matChooserState.matGUID = nil
end

-- Called when a mat thumbnail is clicked
function selectMatImage(player, value, id)
    -- Extract index from button ID (format: "MatSelect_Index")
    local indexStr = id:match("%d+$")
    if not indexStr then return end
    
    local index = tonumber(indexStr)
    local data = MAT_IMAGES[index]
    if not data then return end
    
    -- Find the mat object
    local matObj = getObjectFromGUID(matChooserState.matGUID)
    if not matObj then
        printToColor("Mat object not found!", player.color, {1, 0.3, 0.3})
        return
    end
    
    printToAll("Changing Mat to: " .. data.name, {0.2, 0.8, 0.2})
    
    -- Tell the mat to change its image
    matObj.call("changeMatImage", {url = data.url})
end

MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 99

function onload(saved_data)
    light_mode = false
    tooltip_show = false
    val = 0

    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        light_mode = loaded_data[1]
        val = loaded_data[2]
        tooltip_show = loaded_data[3]
    end

ObjectStates.Description:
Place any die into the center of the pad.

Press + or - to set how many dice you would like roll.

Press the Print button to turn on/off printing.

Click the number to roll the dice. On each roll, any previously rolled dice will be deleted.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--This is the basic distance from the tool a die is spawned
--This number scales with the scale of the tool
distanceFromTool = 3

--This is the option to collect the dice into ascending order
organizeDice = false

--Enables or disables auto-cleanup
-- -1 is off, 0 is no delay, and 1+ is a delay of that many seconds
autoCleanDelay = 5

--Enables or disables the reset to nr of dice
-- anything 0 and below is off, anything above is the nr of dice to reset to
resetNrOfDice = 1

--Set the default angle how the dice are rolled around the dice roller
-- default is 360, so all around the roller
defaultAngle = 180
diceShift = 30

-- Add new variables for target number mode
targetNumber = 3
criticalNumber = targetNumber+2
compareMode = "Equal\n& Above"
compareModes = {"Equal\n& Above", "Equal", "Above", "Below", "Equal\n& Below", "Compare\nOff"}
currentCompareMode = 1

function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {
        ['hmd']=howManyDice, 
        ['pr']=printResults,
        ['tn']=targetNumber,
        ['cm']=currentCompareMode
    }
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        howManyDice = loaded_data.hmd
        printResults = loaded_data.pr
        targetNumber = loaded_data.tn or 3
		criticalNumber = targetNumber+2
        currentCompareMode = 1
    else
        howManyDice = 1
        printResults = false
        targetNumber = 3
		criticalNumber = targetNumber+2
        currentCompareMode = 1
    end

    math.randomseed(os.time())
    diceBeingRolled = {}
    clearLock = false
    rollLock = false

    createDisplayAndFunctionButtons()
end

--Rolling

--Activates rolling process
function buttonClick_roll(_, rollerColor)
    local dieOnPad = findDieOnPad()
    if dieOnPad ~= nil then
        if rollLock == false then
            --Destroys old dice
            buttonClick_clear(_, rollerColor)
            --Spawns and rolls new nice
            rollThisDieType(dieOnPad, rollerColor)
            -- reset nr of dice
            if resetNrOfDice > 0 then
                buttonReset()
            end
        else
            broadcastToColor("Please wait until the dice come to a complete stop before rolling again.", rollerColor, {1,1,1})
        end
    else
        broadcastToColor("Place the die type you want to roll onto the pad and try again.", rollerColor, {1,1,1})
    end
end

-- helper to turn local offsets into world coords, respecting the zone’s yaw
local function localToWorld(zone, localOffset)
    local zp   = zone.getPosition()
    local yaw  = math.rad(zone.getRotation().y)
    local wx   =  localOffset.x * math.cos(yaw)
                 - localOffset.z * math.sin(yaw)
    local wz   =  localOffset.x * math.sin(yaw)
                 + localOffset.z * math.cos(yaw)
    return {
      x = zp.x + wx,
      y = zp.y + localOffset.y,
      z = zp.z + wz,
    }
end

function rollThisDieType(dieOnPad, rollerColor)
    local zone      = getObjectFromGUID("c09728")
    local scale     = zone.getScale()
    local width     = scale.x
    local depth     = scale.z
    local height    = 2             -- spawn height
    local maxPerRow = 20
    local rows      = math.ceil(howManyDice / maxPerRow)

    -- fixed X-spacing for up to 20 dice
    local spacingX      = width / maxPerRow
    local originalStartX = -width/2 + spacingX/2

    local spacingZ = depth / rows
    local startZ    = -depth/2 + spacingZ/2

    function coroutine_rolling()
        diceBeingRolled = {}
        clearLock       = true
        rollLock        = true

        for i = 1, howManyDice do
            local row = math.floor((i-1) / maxPerRow)
            local idx = (i-1) % maxPerRow

            -- shift each new row’s start X by +2 local units
            local offsetX = originalStartX + idx * spacingX + row * 2
            local offsetZ = startZ    + row * spacingZ

            local pos = localToWorld(zone, { x = offsetX, y = height, z = offsetZ })
            local die = dieOnPad.clone({ position = pos })

            die.interactable = false
            table.insert(diceBeingRolled, die)
            die.setRotation(randomRotation())

            coroutine.yield(0); coroutine.yield(0); coroutine.yield(0)
            die.roll()
            wait(0.05)
        end

        watchForDiceToStop(rollerColor)
        return 1
    end

    startLuaCoroutine(self, "coroutine_rolling")
end




function watchForDiceToStop(rollerColor)
    function coroutine_placing()
        dieValueTable, rollString, totalRollValue = {}, "", 0
        local successCount = 0
		local CritCount = 0
        for _, die in ipairs(diceBeingRolled) do
            while die.resting == false do
                coroutine.yield(0)
            end
            local rollValue = die.getValue()
            totalRollValue = totalRollValue + rollValue
            die.interactable = true
            table.insert(dieValueTable, {die=die, val=rollValue})

            -- Check if compare mode is not "Compare\nOff"
            if compareMode ~= "Compare Off" then
                local success = false
				local Crit = false
                if compareMode == "Equal\n& Above" then
                    success = rollValue >= targetNumber
					Crit = rollValue >= criticalNumber
                elseif compareMode == "Equal" then
                    success = rollValue == targetNumber
                elseif compareMode == "Above" then
                    success = rollValue > targetNumber
                elseif compareMode == "Below" then
                    success = rollValue < targetNumber
                elseif compareMode == "Equal\n& Below" then
                    success = rollValue <= targetNumber
                end
                if success then successCount = successCount + 1 end
				if Crit then CritCount = CritCount+1 end
            end
        end

        local sort_func = function(a,b) return a.val < b.val end
        table.sort(dieValueTable, sort_func)

        local angle = defaultAngle
        local spaceToRoll = (howManyDice - 1) * diceShift
        local rollAngle = (spaceToRoll * -1) / 2

        for i, entry in ipairs(dieValueTable) do
            if organizeDice == true then
                local pos = findGlobalPosWithLocalDirection(self, distanceFromTool * self.getScale().x, angle - rollAngle)
                rollAngle = rollAngle + diceShift
                pos.y = pos.y + 0.5
                entry.die.setPositionSmooth(pos)
            end
            if i ~= 1 then rollString = rollString .. ", " end
            rollString = rollString .. entry.val
        end

        -- Broadcast roll results
        if printResults == true then
				broadcastToAll(Player[rollerColor].steam_name .. " rolled: " .. rollString, stringColorToRGB(rollerColor))

			--DELAY HERE 2 Seconds
			wait(2)
            -- Only broadcast comparison results if compareMode is not "Compare Off"
            if compareMode ~= "Compare\nOff" then
                local message = string.format("%d dice rolled, looking for %s %d:[A1E99E] %d[-] successes of which [F4641D]%d[-] are Crits",
                    #diceBeingRolled, compareMode, targetNumber, successCount, CritCount)
                broadcastToAll(message, stringColorToRGB(rollerColor))
            end
        end

        clearLock = false
        rollLock = false

        if autoCleanDelay ~= -1 then
            Timer.destroy("uniqueDelayName" .. self.getGUID())
            Timer.create({
                identifier = "uniqueDelayName" .. self.getGUID(),
                delay = autoCleanDelay,
                function_owner = self,
                function_name = "autoClearTimerFunction"
            })
        end

        return 1
    end
    startLuaCoroutine(self, "coroutine_placing")
end


-- Target Number Mode Functions
function buttonClick_targetChange(obj, playerColor, alt_click)
    if alt_click then
        -- Right-click to decrease target number
        if targetNumber > 1 then
            targetNumber = targetNumber - 1
        end
    else
        -- Left-click to increase target number
        targetNumber = targetNumber + 1
    end

    -- Update critical number whenever target number changes
    criticalNumber = targetNumber + 2

    -- Update button label with new target number
    obj.editButton({index=7, label=tostring(targetNumber)})
end


function buttonClick_targetDown(obj, color, alt_click)
    if targetNumber > 1 then
        targetNumber = targetNumber - 1

        -- Update critical number whenever target number changes
        criticalNumber = targetNumber + 2

        -- Update button label with new target number
        obj.editButton({index=7, label=tostring(targetNumber)})
    end
end

function buttonClick_compareMode(obj, color, alt_click)
    currentCompareMode = (currentCompareMode % #compareModes) + 1
    compareMode = compareModes[currentCompareMode]
    obj.editButton({index=8, label=compareMode})  -- Changed from 9
end

function updateTargetButtons(obj)
    local baseColor = {0,0,0,1}  -- Black background
    local hiddenColor = {0,0,0,0}  -- Transparent/hidden
    
    -- Update target number button visibility
    obj.editButton({
        index=8, 
        color = targetNumberMode and baseColor or hiddenColor
    })
    
    -- Update compare mode button visibility
    obj.editButton({
        index=10, 
        color = targetNumberMode and baseColor or hiddenColor
    })
end

--Printing
function buttonClick_print()
    if printResults == false then printResults = true
    else printResults = false
    end
    local printStatus = "ON"
    if printResults == false then printStatus = "OFF" end
    self.editButton({index=2, label=printStatus})
end

--Clearing
function buttonReset()
    howManyDice = resetNrOfDice
    self.editButton({index=0, label=howManyDice})
end

function buttonClick_clear(_, rollerColor)
    Timer.destroy("uniqueDelayName"..self.getGUID())

    if clearLock == false then
        for _, die in ipairs(diceBeingRolled) do
            if die ~= nil then
                destroyObject(die)
            end
        end
    else
        broadcastToColor("Please do not hit clear until dice come to a complete stop.", rollerColor, {1,1,1})
    end
end

function autoClearTimerFunction()
    buttonClick_clear()
end

--Plus and Minus buttons
function buttonClick_plus()
    howManyDice = howManyDice + 1
    self.editButton({index=0, label=howManyDice})
end

function buttonClick_minus()
    if howManyDice > 1 then howManyDice = howManyDice - 1 end
    self.editButton({index=0, label=howManyDice})
end

--Info finding utility
function findDieOnPad()
    local pos = self.getPosition()
    local objectsInArea = Physics.cast({
        origin=pos, type=2, size={0.2,0.1,0.2},
        direction={0,1,0}, max_distance=3
    })
    for _, entry in ipairs(objectsInArea) do
        if entry.hit_object.tag == "Dice" then
            return entry.hit_object
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function findProximity(targetPos, object)
    local objectPos = object.getPosition()
    local xDistance = math.abs(targetPos.x - objectPos.x)
    local zDistance = math.abs(targetPos.z - objectPos.z)
    local distance = xDistance^2 + zDistance^2
    return math.sqrt(distance)
end

function findGlobalPosWithLocalDirection(object, distance, angle)
    local startAngle = angle
    local oPos, oRot = object.getPosition(), object.getRotation()
    local posX = oPos.x + math.sin( math.rad(startAngle+oRot.y) ) * distance
    local posY = oPos.y
    local posZ = oPos.z + math.cos( math.rad(startAngle+oRot.y) ) * distance
    return {x=posX, y=posY, z=posZ}
end

function randomRotation()
    local u1 = math.random()
    local u2 = math.random()
    local u3 = math.random()
    local u1sqrt = math.sqrt(u1)
    local u1m1sqrt = math.sqrt(1-u1)
    local qx = u1m1sqrt *math.sin(2*math.pi*u2)
    local qy = u1m1sqrt *math.cos(2*math.pi*u2)
    local qz = u1sqrt *math.sin(2*math.pi*u3)
    local qw = u1sqrt *math.cos(2*math.pi*u3)
    local ysqr = qy * qy
    local t0 = -2.0 * (ysqr + qz * qz) + 1.0
    local t1 = 2.0 * (qx * qy - qw * qz)
    local t2 = -2.0 * (qx * qz + qw * qy)
    local t3 = 2.0 * (qy * qz - qw * qx)
    local t4 = -2.0 * (qx * qx + ysqr) + 1.0
    if t2 > 1.0 then t2 = 1.0 end
    if t2 < -1.0 then ts = -1.0 end
    local xr = math.asin(t2)
    local yr = math.atan2(t3, t4)
    local zr = math.atan2(t1, t0)
    return {math.deg(xr),math.deg(yr),math.deg(zr)}
end

    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

local current_health = 0
local b_display_health = nil

function onLoad(saved_data)
    -- Initialize button parameters first
    generateButtonParameters()
    
    -- Try to load saved data
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        current_health = loaded_data.health

    -- Create button and update display

    damage_display()

    -- Save the current health value

        health = current_health
    }
    return JSON.encode(data_to_save)
end

    if (alt_click) then
        current_health = current_health - 1
    else
        current_health = current_health + 1

        current_health = 0

    b_display_health = {

        label = '',
        position = {0, 0.05, 0},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        width = 500,

        font_size = 450
    }
end

-- 40mm SHIP SCRIPT V2.0 06/10/2024

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil
};
-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 15       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40      -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 195       -- cost variable

local Signature = 6                 -- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0                        -- Tracker for Silent running 

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
	sigAuraShown = false,
	sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
		state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    -- print("ModifyAura called with amount:", params.amount)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    -- print("New Aura value:", state.conditions.Aura)
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    -- print("Base signature modified. New base value:", SignatureStorage)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        -- print("Signature recalculated. Base sig:", baseSignature, "Spike bonus:", spikeBonus, "Total sig:", state.sig)
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        -- print("Signature aura hidden")
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (state.conditions[name] > 1 and name or secondary))

    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionData = Conditions[imageName]
        local colorValue = conditionData and conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF" -- Default to white if nil
        local colorBlock = colorValue .. ((state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0 and 'ff' or '22')

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageName,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and state.conditions[name] > 0 and 'true' or 'false'),
            text = state.conditions[name]
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then

    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local mode = (state.conditions and state.conditions.Mode) or 0
    local content = mode == 0 and PlayerHUDContainer(color) or Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not content then

    local result = string.format([[

    return result

end

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else
        -- Only create the aura object if it should be visible
        if scale > 0 then
            local clr = {r=1, g=0, b=0}  -- Set color to red
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({
                type = 'custom_model',
                position = self.getPosition(),
                rotation = self.getRotation(),
                scale = {scale, 1, scale},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(b)
                    b.setColorTint(clr)  -- Set the color to red
                    b.setVar('parent', self)
                    b.setLuaScript([[
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                                self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/components/arcs/round0.obj',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    elseif ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

    end

    self.rotate({x=0, y=-5, z=0})
end

    self.rotate({x=0, y=5, z=0})
end

function onLoad(save)

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {

    })

    data.state = state;

    return JSON.encode(data)

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
		state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    -- print("ModifyAura called with amount:", params.amount)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    -- print("New Aura value:", state.conditions.Aura)
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    -- print("Base signature modified. New base value:", SignatureStorage)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        -- print("Signature recalculated. Base sig:", baseSignature, "Spike bonus:", spikeBonus, "Total sig:", state.sig)
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        -- print("Signature aura hidden")
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (state.conditions[name] > 1 and name or secondary))

    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionData = Conditions[imageName]
        local colorValue = conditionData and conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF" -- Default to white if nil
        local colorBlock = colorValue .. ((state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0 and 'ff' or '22')

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageName,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and state.conditions[name] > 0 and 'true' or 'false'),
            text = state.conditions[name]
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0

    local content = mode == 0 and PlayerHUDContainer(color) or Compact_PlayerHUD(color)

    local result = string.format([[

------ Object SPAWNERS ----------------------

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223929022/E9FD1CA7DDCC15521C6B20FB250F5651DCEAEEA0/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else
        -- Only create the aura object if it should be visible
        if scale > 0 then
            local clr = {r=1, g=0, b=0}  -- Set color to red
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({
                type = 'custom_model',
                position = self.getPosition(),
                rotation = self.getRotation(),
                scale = {scale, 1, scale},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(b)
                    b.setColorTint(clr)  -- Set the color to red
                    b.setVar('parent', self)
                    b.setLuaScript([[
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                                self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/components/arcs/round0.obj',

                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    elseif ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function rotate_model(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        rotate_right()
    else
        rotate_left()
    end
end

function rotate_left()

end

function rotate_right()

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- SHIP SCRIPT V2.0 06/10/2024

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil
};
-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 10       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 30     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 195        -- cost variable

local Signature = 4 		-- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0			-- Tracker for Silent running

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
	sigAuraShown = false,
	sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
		state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    -- print("ModifyAura called with amount:", params.amount)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    -- print("New Aura value:", state.conditions.Aura)
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    -- print("Base signature modified. New base value:", SignatureStorage)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        -- print("Signature recalculated. Base sig:", baseSignature, "Spike bonus:", spikeBonus, "Total sig:", state.sig)
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        -- print("Signature aura hidden")
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

------ MODEL MANIPULATION -------------------

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

------ UI GENERATION ------------------------

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (state.conditions[name] > 1 and name or secondary))

    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionData = Conditions[imageName]
        local colorValue = conditionData and conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF" -- Default to white if nil
        local colorBlock = colorValue .. ((state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0 and 'ff' or '22')

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageName,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and state.conditions[name] > 0 and 'true' or 'false'),
            text = state.conditions[name]
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local mode = (state.conditions and state.conditions.Mode) or 0
    local content = mode == 0 and PlayerHUDContainer(color) or Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

function Compact_PlayerHUD(color)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = Compact_HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="60" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 0 -680' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="100%%" height="20" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='18' height="20" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

function PlayerHUDContainer(color)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 -700' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="60" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='25' height="30" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

function Compact_HUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 38
    local size2 = 30
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color,"Atmosphere", -0.5 ,2.5,size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", 2.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 3.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -0.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 1.5, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 0.5, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 2.5, -1, size)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function HUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 60
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color,"Atmosphere", -1 ,1,size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", -1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 4, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -1, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 4, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 4, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 3, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Silent_Running", 0, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Clockwise", 1, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "CounterClockwise", 2, 1, size),
		HUDSingleCondition(color, "TargetSig", -2, 0, size)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function UI_ModifyCondition(alt, name) if alt ~= '-3' then ModifyCondition({ name = name, amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) }) end end

function UI_ModifyAura(p, alt) if alt ~= '-3' then ModifyAura({ amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) }) end end

function UI_ModifyHealth(p, alt) if alt ~= '-3' then ModifyHealth({ amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) }) end end

function UI_ModifyFire(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition(alt, "Fire") end

function UI_ModifyOrbital_Decay(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Orbital_Decay") end
function UI_ModifyScanners_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Scanners_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyWeapons_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Weapons_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyDefence_Systems_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Defence_Systems_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyNavigation_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Navigation_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyActivated(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Activated") end

function UI_ModifyClockwise(p, alt) rotate_right() end
function UI_ModifyCounterClockwise(p, alt) rotate_left() end

function UI_ModifyAtmosphere(p, alt_click) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Atmosphere") end

function UI_ModifySilent_Running(p, alt_click) 
    UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Silent_Running") 
    if cloaked == 1 then
       cloaked = 0
       -- print("Ship is no Longer Silent Running")
    else
       cloaked = 1
       -- print("Ship is Silent Running")
    end
    
    -- Recalculate signature to account for cloaking/decloaking and spikes
    RecalculateSignature()
    
    -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
    TurnOffSigAura()
end

function UI_ModifyMode(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition(alt, "Mode") end

function UI_ModifySpikes(p, alt)
    local previousSpikes = state.conditions.Spikes or 0
    UI_ModifyCondition(alt, "Spikes")
    local currentSpikes = state.conditions.Spikes or 0
    
    -- print("Spikes updated. New spike count:", currentSpikes)
    
    -- Recalculate signature to account for the change in spikes
    RecalculateSignature()
    
    -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
    TurnOffSigAura()
end

function UI_ModifyTargetSig(p, alt) if alt ~= '-3' then ShowSig() end end

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 2)) - (1.5 * size + 2)), y * ((size + 2)))
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%s" height="%s" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size, size, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local secondary = Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].secondary
    local imageName = (secondary == nil and name or (conditionValue > 1 and name or secondary)) or name
    local colorValue = (Conditions[imageName] and Conditions[imageName].color) or "#FFFFFF"
    local colorBlock = colorValue .. (conditionValue > 0 and 'ff' or '22')
    local isActive = (Conditions[name] and Conditions[name].stacks and conditionValue > 0) and 'true' or 'false'
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='LowerLeft' width='%s' height='%s'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%s' text='%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerLeft' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
    ]], color, name, imageName, colorBlock, size, size, color, name, isActive, fontSize, conditionValue)
end

    Silent_Running = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726219174689/CBCB3D234BB8B4587286779123535EE0CC343A98/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false },
    Clockwise = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726219326020/21E2C9B879BF1B1DB8EBEB716BF518B7CC0B149B/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false },
    CounterClockwise = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726219326322/5DD7AE1FF69A41D149D2DF60AC32396512F5C022/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false },
	TargetSig = { url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726219633568/1F28145980C5B3C4D3137A781BA7765F98EEE186/", color = "#FFFFFF", stacks = false }
}

------ Object SPAWNERS ----------------------

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else
        -- Only create the aura object if it should be visible
        if scale > 0 then
            local clr = {r=1, g=0, b=0}  -- Set color to red
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({
                type = 'custom_model',
                position = self.getPosition(),
                rotation = self.getRotation(),
                scale = {scale, 1, scale},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(b)
                    b.setColorTint(clr)  -- Set the color to red
                    b.setVar('parent', self)
                    b.setLuaScript([[
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                                self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/components/arcs/round0.obj',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    elseif ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

-------------Model Rotation-------------------

function rotate_model(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        rotate_right()
    else
        rotate_left()
    end
end

function rotate_left()
    self.rotate({x=0, y=-5, z=0})
end

function rotate_right()
    self.rotate({x=0, y=5, z=0})
end
