ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- 50mm SHIP SCRIPT V3.1 10/20/2024

local BigUI_Height = -1300
local SmallUI_Height = -1280

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil,
    sig_aura_obj = nil
};

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
local Shiphealth = 99       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 50      -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 999       -- cost variable

local Signature = 30        -- Ship Signature Variable
local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0           -- Tracker for Silent running

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0, Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0, Silent_Running = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
    sigAuraShown = false,
    sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil }
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

-- New variable to track the current UI mode
local currentUIMode = 1  -- 0: High Visibility, 1: Subtle, 2: Compact

-- Add this at the top of your script
local UI_SCALE = 1.3  -- Adjust this value to scale all UI elements
local BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000CC"  -- More opaque background
local TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFFFF"  -- Bright white text
local OUTLINE_COLOR = "#000000"
local OUTLINE_SIZE = "2 2"  -- Thicker outline

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the value from the card
    SignatureStorage = state.sig or Signature

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showAura()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    MoveManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
        color = player_color,   -- The color of the player controlling the token
        obj = self              -- The token (self refers to this object)
    })
end

function onDestroy()
    if (ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    if (ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil) then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state;
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state;
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player);
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise","CounterClockwise"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    state.conditions.Aura = math.max(0, math.floor((state.conditions.Aura or 0) + params.amount))
    showAura()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus
    
    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)
    
    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig
        
        -- Turn off sig aura if it was shown
        TurnOffSigAura()
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.SigAura = state.sig
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
    end
    showSigAura()
    SyncCondition("SigAura")
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function TurnOffSigAura()
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.sigAuraShown = false
        state.conditions.SigAura = 0
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        showSigAura()
        SyncCondition("SigAura")
        SyncCondition("TargetSig")
        print("Signature aura turned off due to Silent Running or Spike changes")
    end
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

------ MODEL MANIPULATION -------------------

function AuraFollowObject(params)
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', params.obj);
    end
end

function AuraResetFollow()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self);
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
    
    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 135)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

------ UI GENERATION ------------------------

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
        local conditionData = Conditions[name]
        if not conditionData then
            print("Error: No condition data found for " .. name)
            return
        end
        
        local isActive = conditionValue > 0
        local imageUrl = isActive and conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url
        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
        else
            colorBlock = conditionData.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and 'true' or 'false',
            text = conditionValue
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        RefreshBaseColor()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation();
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end;
    local pointerRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    pointerRotation = math.floor((pointerRotation + 15) / 30)
    if pointerRotation ~= UIStatus[player.color].rotation then
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -30 * pointerRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = pointerRotation;
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""
    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end
    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]] 
        .. panelContent .. 
        [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};
    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };
        end
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color)
    if not UIStatus[color] then 
        return "" 
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then 
        return "" 
    end
    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content)
    return result
end

function getUIContent(color)
    if currentUIMode == 0 then
        return HighVisibilityUI(color, BigUI_Height)
    elseif currentUIMode == 1 then
        return SubtleUI(color, BigUI_Height)  -- Passing BigUI_Height here as well
    else
        return CompactUI(color, SmallUI_Height)
    end
end

local HiVis_BACKPLATE_WIDTH = 498 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the width
local HiVis_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT = 190 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the height

function HighVisibilityUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="%d" width="%d" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">
            <Panel width="100%%" height="100%%" color="%s">
                <Panel height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter">
                    %s
                    <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="%d" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
                    <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='%d' height="%d" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
                </Panel>
            </Panel>
        </Panel>
    ]], HiVis_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT, HiVis_BACKPLATE_WIDTH, height, BACKGROUND_COLOR, conditions, 60 * UI_SCALE, color, percentage, color, 25 * UI_SCALE, 30 * UI_SCALE, healthCurrent, healthMax, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function SubtleUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = HUDConditions(color) or ""
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="180" width="128" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 50 %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">%s
        <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="60" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
        <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='25' height="30" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='#ffffff' fontStyle='Bold' outline='#000000' outlineSize='1 1' />
        </Panel>
    ]], height, conditions, color, percentage, color, healthCurrent, healthMax)
end

local Compact_BACKPLATE_WIDTH = 200 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the width
local Compact_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT = 180 * UI_SCALE  -- Adjust this value to change the height

function CompactUI(color, height)
    if not state.health then return "" end
    local healthCurrent = state.health.current or 0
    local healthMax = state.health.max or 1
    local percentage = (healthCurrent / healthMax * 100) or 0
    local conditions = CompactHUDConditions(color) or ""
    
    -- Define the amount to move the background up
    local backgroundOffsetY = 20 -- Adjust this value to move the background up or down

    return string.format([[
        <Panel id='PlayerHUD_Container' active='true' height="%d" width="%d" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" rotation='-35 0 0' position='0 %d %d' childForceExpandWidth="false">
            <Panel width="100%%" height="100%%" color="%s">
                <Panel height="80" width="78" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" position="0 -%d 0">
                    %s
                    <ProgressBar width="200%%" height="%d" id="%s_HealthBar" color='#00000080' fillImageColor="#44AA22FF" percentage="%s" textColor="#00000000"/>  
                    <Text id='%s_HealthBar_Text' fontSize='%d' height="%d" onClick='UI_ModifyHealth' text='%s/%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
                </Panel>
            </Panel>
        </Panel>
    ]], Compact_BACKPLATE_HEIGHT, Compact_BACKPLATE_WIDTH, 
    50 + backgroundOffsetY, height, 
    BACKGROUND_COLOR, 
    backgroundOffsetY, 
    conditions, 20 * UI_SCALE, color, percentage, color, 18 * UI_SCALE, 20 * UI_SCALE, 
    healthCurrent, healthMax, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function HUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 60
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color,"Atmosphere", -1 ,1,size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", -1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 4, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -1, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 4, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 4, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 3, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Silent_Running", 0, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Clockwise", 1, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "CounterClockwise", 2, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "TargetSig", -2, 0, size)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function SubtleHUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 60
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", -1, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 4, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -1, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 4, 1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 4, 0, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 3, 1, size)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function CompactHUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end
    local size = 38
    local size2 = 30
    local conditions = {
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Fire", 0.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color,"Atmosphere", -0.5 ,2.5,size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Orbital_Decay", 1.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Scanners_Offline", 2.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Weapons_Offline", 3.5, 2.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Defence_Systems_Offline", 2.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Navigation_Offline", 3.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", -0.5, 1.5, size2),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", 1.5, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Activated", 0.5, -1, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", 2.5, -1, size),
		HUDSingleCondition(color, "Silent_Running", 1.5, 1.5, size2),
		HUDSingleCondition(color, "TargetSig", 0.5, 1.5, size2)
    }
    return "<Panel width=\"100%\" rectAlignment=\"MiddleLeft\" position='0 0 0' >" .. table.concat(conditions) .. "</Panel>"
end

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 4) * UI_SCALE) - (1.5 * size + 4) * UI_SCALE), y * ((size + 4) * UI_SCALE))
    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%d" height="%d" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size * UI_SCALE, size * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end
    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end
    
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 1 then  -- Subtle mode
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')  -- Fully opaque when active, partially transparent when inactive
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"  -- Always fully opaque for other modes
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]], color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, size, size, color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, conditionValue, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function UI_ModifyCondition(alt, name)
    if alt ~= '-3' then 
        ModifyCondition({ name = name, amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) })
        SyncCondition(name)  -- Ensure the condition is synced after modification
    end
end

function UI_ModifyAura(p, alt) if alt ~= '-3' then ModifyAura({ amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) }) end end

function UI_ModifyHealth(p, alt) if alt ~= '-3' then ModifyHealth({ amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0) }) end end

function UI_ModifyFire(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition(alt, "Fire") end

function UI_ModifyOrbital_Decay(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Orbital_Decay") end
function UI_ModifyScanners_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Scanners_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyWeapons_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Weapons_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyDefence_Systems_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Defence_Systems_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyNavigation_Offline(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Navigation_Offline") end
function UI_ModifyActivated(p, alt) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Activated") end

function UI_ModifyClockwise(p, alt) rotate_right() end
function UI_ModifyCounterClockwise(p, alt) rotate_left() end

function UI_ModifyAtmosphere(p, alt_click) UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Atmosphere") end

function showAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
    else
        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj = spawnObject({
            type = 'custom_model',
            position = self.getPosition(),
            rotation = self.getRotation(),
            scale = {scale, 1, scale},
            mass = 0,
            use_gravity = false,
            sound = false,
            snap_to_grid = false,
            callback_function = function(b)
                b.setColorTint(clr)
                b.setVar('parent', self)
                b.setLuaScript([[
                    function onUpdate()
                        if parent and parent.getPosition then
                            self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                            self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                        end
                    end
                ]])
                b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
            end
        })
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setCustomObject({
            mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450611726223935325/77C02DD7AC66A61A2F30452D73585D02DFE0D72D/',
            collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
            material = 3,
            specularIntensity = 0,
            cast_shadows = false
        })
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    else
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function showSigAura()
    local auraSize = state.conditions.SigAura or 0

    -- Scale is directly the aura size (in inches)
    local scale = auraSize

    if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        if scale == 0 then
            -- Hide the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        else
            -- Show and update the aura object
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setRotation(self.getRotation())
        end
    else
        -- Only create the aura object if it should be visible
        if scale > 0 then
            local clr = {r=1, g=0, b=0}  -- Set color to red
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj = spawnObject({
                type = 'custom_model',
                position = self.getPosition(),
                rotation = self.getRotation(),
                scale = {scale, 1, scale},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(b)
                    b.setColorTint(clr)  -- Set the color to red
                    b.setVar('parent', self)
                    b.setLuaScript([[
                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                                self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    b.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })
            ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/components/arcs/round0.obj',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    end

    if auraSize == 0 and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({0, 0, 0})
    elseif ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.setScale({scale, 1, scale})
    end
end

function RefreshShip()
    -- Save current state
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
        -- Add any other state variables you need to preserve
    }

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()

    -- Use Wait.frames to delay UI initialization
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Restore saved state
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        -- Reinitialize UI and other visual elements
        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()  -- Ensure UI is fully updated
        RefreshModelShape()
        showAura()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        
        -- Recalculate any derived values
        RecalculateSignature()

        print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)  -- Wait for 2 frames before initializing UI
end

-- Red Secondary Selection
local objectives = {
    {name="Key Site", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128192859/8C40325733D3EEBC309D7A910BABE1A6E0D81130/"},
    {name="Priority Target", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128196308/73606C6976F3A0C188D679E1FEC37F76C1089731/"},
    {name="Long Shot", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128193869/2B194864A8CFE8B34DA891B85CBEBA9CA7C4AA75/"},
    {name="Annihilate", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128188714/AA6206E433D35163A82CAFB57C624915B926078C/"},
    {name="Take Prizes", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128197543/95D757A1E622649F18800BDF0320899B4872E537/"},
    {name="Gather Intel", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128191687/98FC185E1D9596D7533803D8686445F362B90A96/"},
    {name="Decapitate", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128190550/25EB74AD426E5B75C0F34B2C10D362BA7DEB58BC/"},
    {name="Objectives Beyond", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128195035/CDA9B5A08FF4E4B9875E8BD55437B8C510CFF051/"}
}

local selectedIndices = {}

function onLoad()
    createButtons()
end

function createButtons()
    self.clearButtons()
    
    -- Using a larger scale for "far too small" fix
    local btnScale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5}
    local titleZ = -3.1
    local startZ = -2.5
    local spacing = 0.6
    
    -- Label: "Select Secondaries:"
    self.createButton({
        label="Select Secondaries:",
        click_function="none",
        function_owner=self,
        position={0, 2, titleZ},
        height=600,
        width=3500,
        font_size=400,
        color={0.5, 0.5, 0.5},
        font_color={1,1,1},
        scale=btnScale
    })

    -- Render Option Buttons in a Vertical Column (one above the other)
    for i, obj in ipairs(objectives) do
        local isSelected = false
        for _, v in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
            if v == i then isSelected = true break end
        end

        local col = {0, 0, 0} -- Black by default
        if isSelected then col = {0.2, 0.8, 0.2} end -- Green highlight for selected

        local funcName = "clickObj_" .. i
        _G[funcName] = function() onOptionClick(i) end
        
        self.createButton({
            label=obj.name,
            click_function=funcName,
            function_owner=self,
            position={0, 2, startZ + (i-1)*spacing},
            height=600,
            width=2800,
            font_size=350,
            color=col,
            font_color={1,1,1}, -- White text
            scale=btnScale
        })
    end

    -- Done Button
    if #selectedIndices == 2 then
        local doneZ = startZ + (#objectives * spacing) + 0.1
        self.createButton({
            label="Done",
            click_function="clickDone",
            function_owner=self,
            position={0, 2, doneZ},
            height=800,
            width=3000,
            font_size=500,
            color={0.1, 0.9, 0.1},
            font_color={1,1,1},
            scale=btnScale
        })
    end
end

function onOptionClick(index)
    local foundIdx = -1
    for k, v in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
        if v == index then
            foundIdx = k
            break
        end
    end

    if foundIdx ~= -1 then
        -- Deselect
        table.remove(selectedIndices, foundIdx)
    else
        -- Select
        if #selectedIndices < 2 then
            table.insert(selectedIndices, index)
        else
            -- Already 2 selected, do not allow more
            return
        end
    end
    createButtons()
end

function clickDone()
    spawnCards()
    self.clearButtons()
    -- Permanently end process: do nothing more.
end

function spawnCards()
    -- Get current object position/rotation
    local pos = self.getPosition()
    local rot = self.getRotation()
    local right = self.getTransformRight()
    local up = self.getTransformUp()
    
    -- Spawning 2 cards centered above
    -- Offset them slightly left and right
    local spacing = 2.5
    
    for i, idx in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
        local objData = objectives[idx]
        
        -- Calculate position
        -- Center is pos + up * 3
        -- Left/Right is right * offset
        local offset = (i == 1) and -spacing/2 or spacing/2
        
        local spawnPos = {

function createButtons()
    self.clearButtons()
    
    -- Using a larger scale for "far too small" fix
    local btnScale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5}
    local titleZ = -3.1
    local startZ = -2.5
    local spacing = 0.6
    
    -- Label: "Select Secondaries:"
    self.createButton({
        label="Select Secondaries:",
        click_function="none",
        function_owner=self,

        font_size=400,
        color={0.5, 0.5, 0.5},

    })

    -- Render Option Buttons in a Vertical Column (one above the other)
    for i, obj in ipairs(objectives) do
        local isSelected = false
        for _, v in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
            if v == i then isSelected = true break end
        end

        local col = {0, 0, 0} -- Black by default
        if isSelected then col = {0.2, 0.8, 0.2} end -- Green highlight for selected

        local funcName = "clickObj_" .. i
        _G[funcName] = function() onOptionClick(i) end

            function_owner=self,

            font_size=350,
            color=col,

function onOptionClick(index)
    local foundIdx = -1
    for k, v in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
        if v == index then
            foundIdx = k
            break
        end
    end

    if foundIdx ~= -1 then
        -- Deselect
        table.remove(selectedIndices, foundIdx)
    else
        -- Select
        if #selectedIndices < 2 then
            table.insert(selectedIndices, index)
        else
            -- Already 2 selected, do not allow more

        end
    end
    createButtons()

    -- Get current object position/rotation

    local rot = self.getRotation()
    local right = self.getTransformRight()
    local up = self.getTransformUp()
    
    -- Spawning 2 cards centered above

    for i, idx in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
        local objData = objectives[idx]

        local spawnPos = {
            x = pos.x + right.x * offset + up.x * 2,
            y = pos.y + right.y * offset + up.y * 2 + 2, -- +2 height to drop

        card.setCustomObject({
            face = objData.url,
            back = objData.url
        })
        card.setName(objData.name)
    end
end

ObjectStates.Description:
Place any die into the center of the pad.

Press + or - to set how many dice you would like roll.

Press the Print button to turn on/off printing.

Click the number to roll the dice. On each roll, any previously rolled dice will be deleted.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--This is the basic distance from the tool a die is spawned
--This number scales with the scale of the tool
distanceFromTool = 3

--This is the option to collect the dice into ascending order
organizeDice = false

--Enables or disables auto-cleanup
-- -1 is off, 0 is no delay, and 1+ is a delay of that many seconds
autoCleanDelay = 5

--Enables or disables the reset to nr of dice
-- anything 0 and below is off, anything above is the nr of dice to reset to
resetNrOfDice = 1

--Set the default angle how the dice are rolled around the dice roller
-- default is 360, so all around the roller
defaultAngle = 180
diceShift = 30

-- Add new variables for target number mode
targetNumber = 3
criticalNumber = targetNumber+2
compareMode = "Equal\n& Above"
compareModes = {"Equal\n& Above", "Equal", "Above", "Below", "Equal\n& Below", "Compare\nOff"}
currentCompareMode = 1

function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {
        ['hmd']=howManyDice, 
        ['pr']=printResults,
        ['tn']=targetNumber,
        ['cm']=currentCompareMode
    }
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        howManyDice = loaded_data.hmd
        printResults = loaded_data.pr
        targetNumber = loaded_data.tn or 3
		criticalNumber = targetNumber+2
        currentCompareMode = 1
    else
        howManyDice = 1
        printResults = false
        targetNumber = 3
		criticalNumber = targetNumber+2
        currentCompareMode = 1
    end

    math.randomseed(os.time())
    diceBeingRolled = {}
    clearLock = false
    rollLock = false

    createDisplayAndFunctionButtons()
end

--Rolling

--Activates rolling process
function buttonClick_roll(_, rollerColor)
    local dieOnPad = findDieOnPad()
    if dieOnPad ~= nil then
        if rollLock == false then
            --Destroys old dice
            buttonClick_clear(_, rollerColor)
            --Spawns and rolls new nice
            rollThisDieType(dieOnPad, rollerColor)
            -- reset nr of dice
            if resetNrOfDice > 0 then
                buttonReset()
            end
        else
            broadcastToColor("Please wait until the dice come to a complete stop before rolling again.", rollerColor, {1,1,1})
        end
    else
        broadcastToColor("Place the die type you want to roll onto the pad and try again.", rollerColor, {1,1,1})
    end
end

-- helper to turn local offsets into world coords, respecting the zone’s yaw
local function localToWorld(zone, localOffset)
    local zp   = zone.getPosition()
    local yaw  = math.rad(zone.getRotation().y)
    local wx   =  localOffset.x * math.cos(yaw)
                 - localOffset.z * math.sin(yaw)
    local wz   =  localOffset.x * math.sin(yaw)
                 + localOffset.z * math.cos(yaw)
    return {
      x = zp.x + wx,
      y = zp.y + localOffset.y,
      z = zp.z + wz,
    }
end

function rollThisDieType(dieOnPad, rollerColor)
    local zone      = getObjectFromGUID("c09728")
    local scale     = zone.getScale()
    local width     = scale.x
    local depth     = scale.z
    local height    = 2             -- spawn height
    local maxPerRow = 20
    local rows      = math.ceil(howManyDice / maxPerRow)

    -- fixed X-spacing for up to 20 dice
    local spacingX      = width / maxPerRow
    local originalStartX = -width/2 + spacingX/2

    local spacingZ = depth / rows
    local startZ    = -depth/2 + spacingZ/2

    function coroutine_rolling()
        diceBeingRolled = {}
        clearLock       = true
        rollLock        = true

        for i = 1, howManyDice do
            local row = math.floor((i-1) / maxPerRow)
            local idx = (i-1) % maxPerRow

            -- shift each new row’s start X by +2 local units
            local offsetX = originalStartX + idx * spacingX + row * 2
            local offsetZ = startZ    + row * spacingZ

            local pos = localToWorld(zone, { x = offsetX, y = height, z = offsetZ })
            local die = dieOnPad.clone({ position = pos })

            die.interactable = false
            table.insert(diceBeingRolled, die)
            die.setRotation(randomRotation())

            coroutine.yield(0); coroutine.yield(0); coroutine.yield(0)
            die.roll()
            wait(0.05)
        end

        watchForDiceToStop(rollerColor)
        return 1
    end

    startLuaCoroutine(self, "coroutine_rolling")
end




function watchForDiceToStop(rollerColor)
    function coroutine_placing()
        dieValueTable, rollString, totalRollValue = {}, "", 0
        local successCount = 0
		local CritCount = 0
        for _, die in ipairs(diceBeingRolled) do
            while die.resting == false do
                coroutine.yield(0)
            end
            local rollValue = die.getValue()
            totalRollValue = totalRollValue + rollValue
            die.interactable = true
            table.insert(dieValueTable, {die=die, val=rollValue})

            -- Check if compare mode is not "Compare\nOff"
            if compareMode ~= "Compare Off" then
                local success = false
				local Crit = false
                if compareMode == "Equal\n& Above" then
                    success = rollValue >= targetNumber
					Crit = rollValue >= criticalNumber
                elseif compareMode == "Equal" then
                    success = rollValue == targetNumber
                elseif compareMode == "Above" then
                    success = rollValue > targetNumber
                elseif compareMode == "Below" then
                    success = rollValue < targetNumber
                elseif compareMode == "Equal\n& Below" then
                    success = rollValue <= targetNumber
                end
                if success then successCount = successCount + 1 end
				if Crit then CritCount = CritCount+1 end
            end
        end

        local sort_func = function(a,b) return a.val < b.val end
        table.sort(dieValueTable, sort_func)

        local angle = defaultAngle
        local spaceToRoll = (howManyDice - 1) * diceShift
        local rollAngle = (spaceToRoll * -1) / 2

        for i, entry in ipairs(dieValueTable) do
            if organizeDice == true then
                local pos = findGlobalPosWithLocalDirection(self, distanceFromTool * self.getScale().x, angle - rollAngle)
                rollAngle = rollAngle + diceShift
                pos.y = pos.y + 0.5
                entry.die.setPositionSmooth(pos)
            end
            if i ~= 1 then rollString = rollString .. ", " end
            rollString = rollString .. entry.val
        end

        -- Broadcast roll results
        if printResults == true then
				broadcastToAll(Player[rollerColor].steam_name .. " rolled: " .. rollString, stringColorToRGB(rollerColor))

			--DELAY HERE 2 Seconds
			wait(2)
            -- Only broadcast comparison results if compareMode is not "Compare Off"
            if compareMode ~= "Compare\nOff" then
                local message = string.format("%d dice rolled, looking for %s %d:[A1E99E] %d[-] successes of which [F4641D]%d[-] are Crits",
                    #diceBeingRolled, compareMode, targetNumber, successCount, CritCount)
                broadcastToAll(message, stringColorToRGB(rollerColor))
            end
        end

        clearLock = false
        rollLock = false

        if autoCleanDelay ~= -1 then
            Timer.destroy("uniqueDelayName" .. self.getGUID())
            Timer.create({
                identifier = "uniqueDelayName" .. self.getGUID(),
                delay = autoCleanDelay,
                function_owner = self,
                function_name = "autoClearTimerFunction"
            })
        end

        return 1
    end
    startLuaCoroutine(self, "coroutine_placing")
end

--Info finding utility
function findDieOnPad()
    local pos = self.getPosition()
    local objectsInArea = Physics.cast({
        origin=pos, type=2, size={0.2,0.1,0.2},
        direction={0,1,0}, max_distance=3
    })
    for _, entry in ipairs(objectsInArea) do
        if entry.hit_object.tag == "Dice" then
            return entry.hit_object
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function findProximity(targetPos, object)
    local objectPos = object.getPosition()
    local xDistance = math.abs(targetPos.x - objectPos.x)
    local zDistance = math.abs(targetPos.z - objectPos.z)
    local distance = xDistance^2 + zDistance^2
    return math.sqrt(distance)
end

function findGlobalPosWithLocalDirection(object, distance, angle)
    local startAngle = angle
    local oPos, oRot = object.getPosition(), object.getRotation()
    local posX = oPos.x + math.sin( math.rad(startAngle+oRot.y) ) * distance
    local posY = oPos.y
    local posZ = oPos.z + math.cos( math.rad(startAngle+oRot.y) ) * distance
    return {x=posX, y=posY, z=posZ}
end

function randomRotation()
    local u1 = math.random()
    local u2 = math.random()
    local u3 = math.random()
    local u1sqrt = math.sqrt(u1)
    local u1m1sqrt = math.sqrt(1-u1)
    local qx = u1m1sqrt *math.sin(2*math.pi*u2)
    local qy = u1m1sqrt *math.cos(2*math.pi*u2)
    local qz = u1sqrt *math.sin(2*math.pi*u3)
    local qw = u1sqrt *math.cos(2*math.pi*u3)
    local ysqr = qy * qy
    local t0 = -2.0 * (ysqr + qz * qz) + 1.0
    local t1 = 2.0 * (qx * qy - qw * qz)
    local t2 = -2.0 * (qx * qz + qw * qy)
    local t3 = 2.0 * (qy * qz - qw * qx)
    local t4 = -2.0 * (qx * qx + ysqr) + 1.0
    if t2 > 1.0 then t2 = 1.0 end
    if t2 < -1.0 then ts = -1.0 end
    local xr = math.asin(t2)
    local yr = math.atan2(t3, t4)
    local zr = math.atan2(t1, t0)
    return {math.deg(xr),math.deg(yr),math.deg(zr)}
end

function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[
    Ship Picker Script - PHR Faction
    ---------------------------------
    A ship card selection tool that saves card data and displays them in a searchable
    XML UI interface. Players can browse ships by tonnage category, search by name,
    select multiple cards, and spawn them to their play area.
    
    Features:
    - Setup Mode: Select cards to save using box-selection
    - Card JSON saving: Captures card data including nested scripts
    - View Ships: Opens XML UI in player's Global UI showing all saved cards
    - Tonnage Tabs: Light, Medium, Heavy, Colossal (based on baseScale in card script)
    - Search Function: Filter cards by name
    - Multi-select: Click cards to highlight green for selection
    - Spawn to Player Area: Spawns selected cards in a line at player's position
--]]

--==============================================================================
-- CONFIGURATION
--==============================================================================

CONFIG = {
    -- Faction name (used in broadcasts and UI title)
    FACTION_NAME = "PHR",
    
    -- UI appearance settings
    UI = {
        -- Main panel dimensions
        PANEL_WIDTH = 720,
        PANEL_HEIGHT = 820,
        
        -- Card grid settings (legacy, kept for compatibility)
        CARDS_PER_ROW = 3,
        CARD_WIDTH = 350,
        CARD_HEIGHT = 490,
        CARD_SPACING = 10,
        
        -- Colors
        PANEL_COLOR = "rgba(0.1, 0.1, 0.15, 1)",
        TAB_COLOR = "rgba(0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 1)",
        TAB_SELECTED_COLOR = "rgba(0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 1)",
        CARD_COLOR = "rgba(0.25, 0.25, 0.35, 1)",
        CARD_SELECTED_COLOR = "rgba(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1)",
        BUTTON_COLOR = "rgba(0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1)",
        CLOSE_BUTTON_COLOR = "rgba(0.8, 0.2, 0.2, 1)",
        TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFF",
        SEARCH_BG_COLOR = "rgba(0.15, 0.15, 0.2, 1)",
        
        --======================================================================
        -- ELEMENT SIZE CONTROLS
        --======================================================================
        
        -- Search Row: Input field and Clear button
        SEARCH_ROW_HEIGHT = 28,          -- Height for the entire search row
        SEARCH_INPUT_WIDTH = 200,        -- Width of the search text input
        CLEAR_BUTTON_WIDTH = 100,         -- Width of the Clear button
        CLEAR_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 28,        -- Height of the Clear button
        
        -- Close (X) Button
        CLOSE_BUTTON_WIDTH = 28,         -- Width of the X button
        CLOSE_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 28,        -- Height of the X button
        
        -- Tonnage Tabs Row
        TABS_ROW_HEIGHT = 35,            -- Height for the tonnage tabs row
        
        -- Arrow Buttons (Left/Right navigation)
        ARROW_BUTTON_WIDTH = 75,         -- Width of arrow buttons
        -- Arrow height is flexible (fills available vertical space)
        
        -- Spawn Button
        SPAWN_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 45,        -- Height of the Spawn Ship Card button
        
        -- Font sizes
        FONT_SIZE_SEARCH = 13,
        FONT_SIZE_TABS = 25,
        FONT_SIZE_ARROWS = 60,
        FONT_SIZE_SPAWN = 32,
        FONT_SIZE_CLOSE = 14,
    },
    
    -- Player spawn positions (where first card spawns for each player color)
    -- Cards spawn left-to-right from this position
    PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS = {
        ["Red"] = {
            position = {x = -27.08, y = 1.36, z = 9.78},
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 270, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 0, y = 0, z = -1}, -- Cards spawn along -Z axis ("Right" for Red)
        },
        ["Blue"] = {
            position = {x = 27.08, y = 1.36, z = -9.78},
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 90, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1}, -- Cards spawn along +Z axis ("Left" for Blue)
        },
        -- Add more player colors as needed
    },
    
    -- Spacing between spawned cards
    CARD_SPAWN_SPACING = 2.92,
    
    -- Tonnage categories based on baseScale values in card scripts
    -- Format: { {name="CategoryName", minScale=X, maxScale=Y}, ... }
    -- Adjust these ranges based on your actual baseScale values
    TONNAGE_CATEGORIES = {
        {name = "Light", minScale = 0, maxScale = 1.49},
        {name = "Medium", minScale = 1.5, maxScale = 2.49},
        {name = "Heavy", minScale = 2.5, maxScale = 3.99},
        {name = "Colossal", minScale = 4.0, maxScale = 999},
    },
}

--==============================================================================
-- STATE VARIABLES
--==============================================================================

-- Array of saved ship card data
-- Format: { {json=string, name=string, imageURL=string, tonnage=string, baseScale=number} }
savedShipCards = {}

-- Backup used during setup mode
savedShipCardsBackup = {}

-- Tracks which cards are currently selected in the UI (per player)
-- Format: { [playerColor] = { [cardIndex] = true/false } }
playerSelections = {}

-- Tracks the current card index being viewed (per player)
playerCardIndices = {}

-- Tracks the current search filter (per player)
-- Format: { [playerColor] = "searchString" }
playerSearchFilters = {}

-- Tracks the current active tab (per player)
-- Format: { [playerColor] = "tabName" }
playerActiveTabs = {}

-- Tracks the number of spawned cards for each player to determine position
-- Format: { [playerColor] = number }
playerSpawnCounts = {}

-- Whether this picker has been configured (has cards saved)
fresh = true

-- The GUID of this object (for UI callback targeting)
selfGUID = ""

--==============================================================================
-- SAVE/LOAD FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Saves data by embedding it directly into the Lua script
function updateSave()
    local script = self.getLuaScript()
    
    -- Find where the embedded data section starts
    local dataStartPattern = "\n%-%-EMBEDDED_DATA_START"
    local dataStart = script:find(dataStartPattern)
    
    if dataStart then
        -- Remove old embedded data (everything after the marker)
        script = script:sub(1, dataStart - 1)
    end
    
    -- Build the embedded data section
    local embeddedData = "\n--EMBEDDED_DATA_START\n"
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "savedShipCards = {\n"
    
    for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  {\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    name = [=[" .. (card.name or "Unknown") .. "]=],\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    imageURL = [=[" .. (card.imageURL or "") .. "]=],\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    tonnage = [=[" .. (card.tonnage or "Light") .. "]=],\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    baseScale = " .. (card.baseScale or 1) .. ",\n"
        if card.json then
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    json = [=[" .. card.json .. "]=],\n"
        end
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  },\n"
    end
    
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "}\n\n"
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "fresh = " .. tostring(fresh) .. "\n"
    
    -- Append the embedded data to the script
    script = script .. embeddedData
    
    -- Update the script
    self.setLuaScript(script)
end

-- Called when the object is loaded
function onLoad(saved_data)
    selfGUID = self.getGUID()
    
    -- Initialize variables if they don't exist
    if savedShipCards == nil then
        savedShipCards = {}
    end
    if fresh == nil then
        fresh = true
    end
    
    -- Update fresh status based on data
    if #savedShipCards > 0 then
        fresh = false
    end
    
    -- Initialize player state tables
    playerSelections = {}
    playerCardIndices = {}
    playerSearchFilters = {}
    playerActiveTabs = {}
    playerSpawnCounts = {}
    
    -- Clean loaded data
    for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        if card.json then card.json = stripBrackets(card.json) end
        if card.imageURL then card.imageURL = stripBrackets(card.imageURL) end
    end
    
    -- Show appropriate buttons
    if fresh then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMainButtons()
    end
end

--==============================================================================
-- BUTTON CREATION FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Creates the initial Setup button when no cards are saved
function createSetupButton()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    self.createButton({
        label = "Setup",
        click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, 0},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 800,
        font_size = 250,
        color = {0.2, 0.2, 0.3},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
end

-- Creates the main action buttons (View Ships, Setup)
function createMainButtons()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    -- View Ships button (main action)
    self.createButton({
        label = "View Ships",
        click_function = "buttonClick_viewShips",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, 1},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = 260,
        width = 800,
        font_size = 160,
        color = {0.55, 0.5, 0.35},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
    
    -- Setup button (to modify saved cards)
    self.createButton({
        label = "Setup",
        click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, 1.36},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = 230,
        width = 550,
        scale = {0.4, 0.4, 0.4},
        font_size = 200,
        color = {0.2, 0.2, 0.3},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
end

-- Creates buttons during Setup mode
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()
    
    -- Cancel button
    self.createButton({
        label = "Cancel",
        click_function = "buttonClick_cancel",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, 1.5},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = 300,
        width = 900,
        font_size = 200,
        color = {0.4, 0.2, 0.2},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
    
    -- Add button
    self.createButton({
        label = "Add Ships",
        click_function = "buttonClick_add",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, 0},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = 300,
        width = 1000,
        font_size = 200,
        color = {0.2, 0.5, 0.2},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
    
    -- Remove button (only if cards exist)
    if not fresh then
        self.createButton({
            label = "Remove Ships",
            click_function = "buttonClick_remove",
            function_owner = self,
            position = {0, 1, 0.6},
            rotation = {0, 0, 0},
            height = 300,
            width = 1100,
            font_size = 200,
            color = {0.5, 0.2, 0.2},
            font_color = {1, 1, 1}
        })
    end
    
    -- Reset button
    self.createButton({
        label = "Reset",
        click_function = "buttonClick_reset",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 1, -3},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = 300,
        width = 900,
        font_size = 200,
        color = {0.3, 0.3, 0.3},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    })
end

--==============================================================================
-- SETUP MODE FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

-- Enters setup mode
function buttonClick_setup()
    savedShipCardsBackup = duplicateTable(savedShipCards)
    createSetupActionButtons()
    broadcastToAll("Setup Mode: Box-select ship cards, then click Add/Remove", {1, 1, 1})
end

-- Cancel setup
function buttonClick_cancel()
    savedShipCards = savedShipCardsBackup
    
    if #savedShipCards == 0 then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMainButtons()
    end
    
    broadcastToAll("Setup Canceled", {1, 1, 1})
end

-- Add selected cards to memory
function buttonClick_add(obj, player_color)
    local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
    local count = 0
    
    for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
        if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() and selectedObj ~= self then
            -- Check if it's a card or tile
            if selectedObj.tag == "Card" or selectedObj.tag == "Tile" then
                -- Check if already saved (by name comparison)
                local cardName = selectedObj.getName()
                local alreadyExists = false
                
                for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
                    if saved.name == cardName then
                        alreadyExists = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                
                if not alreadyExists then
                    -- Extract card data
                    local cardData = extractCardData(selectedObj)
                    if cardData then
                        table.insert(savedShipCards, cardData)
                        count = count + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if count > 0 then
        fresh = false
        -- Sort cards alphabetically
        sortShipCards()
        updateSave()
        broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) added to " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {0.2, 1, 0.2})
    else
        broadcastToAll("No new cards to add (select Card objects)", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
    end
    
    createMainButtons()
end

-- Remove selected cards from memory
function buttonClick_remove(obj, player_color)
    local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
    local count = 0
    
    local newSavedCards = {}
    
    for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        local shouldRemove = false
        
        for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
            if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
                if selectedObj.getName() == saved.name then
                    shouldRemove = true
                    count = count + 1
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        
        if not shouldRemove then
            table.insert(newSavedCards, saved)
        end
    end
    
    savedShipCards = newSavedCards

-- Extracts card data from a card object
function extractCardData(cardObj)
    if not cardObj then return nil end
    
    -- Only allow Tile objects
    if cardObj.tag ~= "Tile" then
        broadcastToAll("Ignored object: Only Tile objects can be saved.", {1, 0.5, 0})
        return nil 
    end
    
    local cardData = {
        name = cardObj.getName() or "Unknown Ship",
        json = nil,
        imageURL = "",
        tonnage = "Light",
        baseScale = 1,
    }

    -- Capture the exact JSON of the object (Tile)
    -- We use this exactly as saved for spawning
    cardData.json = cardObj.getJSON()
    
    -- Extract Image URL for the UI listing (from CustomObject)
    local customObj = cardObj.getCustomObject()
    if customObj and customObj.image then
        cardData.imageURL = customObj.image
    end
    
    -- Tonnage detection from Description (case-insensitive, matches anywhere)
    local desc = cardObj.getDescription() or ""
    local descLower = string.lower(desc)

    if string.find(descLower, "%f[%a]light%f[%A]") then
        cardData.tonnage = "Light"
    elseif string.find(descLower, "%f[%a]medium%f[%A]") then
        cardData.tonnage = "Medium"
    elseif string.find(descLower, "%f[%a]heavy%f[%A]") then
        cardData.tonnage = "Heavy"
    elseif string.find(descLower, "%f[%a]colossal%f[%A]") then
        cardData.tonnage = "Colossal"
    else
        cardData.tonnage = "Light" -- Default
    end
    
    -- Attempt to find baseScale in the Lua script for Tonnage Category sorting
    -- (This preserves the existing logic for categorizing ships in the UI)
    local script = cardObj.getLuaScript()
    if script then
        local scale = script:match("baseScale%s*=%s*([%d%.]+)")
        if scale then
            cardData.baseScale = tonumber(scale)
        end
    end
    
    return cardData
end


-- Sorts ship cards alphabetically by name
function sortShipCards()
    table.sort(savedShipCards, function(a, b)
        return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
    end)
end

-- Gets filtered cards based on active tab and search filter
function getFilteredCards(activeTab, searchFilter)
    local filtered = {}
    local searchLower = string.lower(searchFilter or "")
    
    for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        local matchesTab = (activeTab == "All") or (card.tonnage == activeTab)
        local matchesSearch = (searchFilter == "") or string.find(string.lower(card.name or ""), searchLower, 1, true)
        
        if matchesTab and matchesSearch then
            local cardCopy = duplicateTable(card)
            cardCopy.originalIndex = i
            table.insert(filtered, cardCopy)
        end
    end
    
    return filtered
end

-- Counts cards in a specific tonnage category
function countCardsInCategory(categoryName)
    local count = 0
    for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        if card.tonnage == categoryName then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

-- Escapes special XML characters
function escapeXml(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    str = str:gsub("&", "&")
    str = str:gsub("<", "<")
    str = str:gsub(">", ">")
    str = str:gsub('"', """)
    str = str:gsub("'", "'")
    return str
end

-- Spawns selected cards for a player at their play area
function spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, cardIndices)
    if not playerSpawnCounts then playerSpawnCounts = {} end

    local spawnConfig = CONFIG.PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS[playerColor]
    
    if not spawnConfig then
        -- Default spawn position if player color not configured
        spawnConfig = {
            position = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0},
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
        }
        broadcastToColor("Warning: No spawn position configured for " .. playerColor .. ", using center.", playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
    end
    
    local startPos = spawnConfig.position
    local rotation = spawnConfig.rotation
    local direction = spawnConfig.direction
    local spacing = CONFIG.CARD_SPAWN_SPACING
    
    -- Get persistent spawn count for this player
    local currentCount = playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] or 0
    
    for i, cardIndex in ipairs(cardIndices) do
        local card = savedShipCards[cardIndex]
        if card and card.json then
            -- Calculate spawn position based on cumulative count
            local offset = currentCount * spacing
            local spawnPos = {
                x = startPos.x + (direction.x * offset),
                y = startPos.y + (direction.y * offset),
                z = startPos.z + (direction.z * offset),
            }
            
            -- Spawn the card
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = card.json,
                position = spawnPos,
                rotation = rotation,
                sound = true,
            })
            
            -- Increment count for next card
            currentCount = currentCount + 1
        end
    end
    
    -- Update persistent count
    playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] = currentCount
end

-- Duplicates a table (shallow copy for simple tables, recursive for nested)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    if type(oldTable) ~= "table" then return oldTable end
    
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        if type(v) == "table" then
            newTable[k] = duplicateTable(v)
        else
            newTable[k] = v
        end
    end
    return newTable
end

-- Rounds a number to the specified decimal places
function round(num, dec)
    local mult = 10 ^ (dec or 0)
    return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

-- Strips surrounding brackets [[...]] from a string if present
function stripBrackets(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    -- Check for [=[ ... ]=] style first
    local s, e = str:find("^%[=%[.*%]=%]$")
    if s then return str:sub(4, -4) end
    
    -- Check for [[ ... ]] style
    s, e = str:find("^%[%[.*%]%]$")
    if s then return str:sub(3, -3) end
    
    return str
end

function onload()
    self.interactable = false

    createButtons()

-- group offset for positioning all buttons together
buttonGroupOffset = {x = -22, y = 0.0, z = -25.5}
-- group scale for sizing/spacing all buttons together
buttonGroupScale = 1.5

local function scaled(v)
    return math.max(1, math.floor((v or 0) * buttonGroupScale))
end

local function addOffset(pos)
    return { (pos[1] or 0) * (buttonGroupScale or 1) + (buttonGroupOffset.x or 0), (pos[2] or 0) * (buttonGroupScale or 1) + (buttonGroupOffset.y or 0), (pos[3] or 0) * (buttonGroupScale or 1) + (buttonGroupOffset.z or 0) }
end

function setButtonGroupOffset(x, y, z)
    buttonGroupOffset = { x = x or 0, y = y or 0, z = z or 0 }
    createButtons()
end

function setButtonGroupScale(s)
    buttonGroupScale = s or 1.0
    createButtons()
end

function createButtons()
    if self.clearButtons then self.clearButtons() end

    self.createButton({
        label = "Table Style:",
        position = addOffset({0, 0.2, 0}),
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        width = scaled(1600), height = scaled(400), font_size = scaled(250),
        color = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}, font_color = {1,1,1,1},
        click_function = "nop", function_owner = self
    })

    self.createButton({
        label = "Planet View",
        position = addOffset({0, 0.2, -0.8}),
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        width = scaled(1400), height = scaled(400), font_size = scaled(200),
        color = {0, 0, 0, 1}, font_color = {1,1,1,1},
        click_function = "setPlanetView", function_owner = self
    })

    self.createButton({
        label = "Clean",
        position = addOffset({0, 0.2, -1.6}),
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        width = scaled(1200), height = scaled(400), font_size = scaled(200),
        color = {0, 0, 0, 1}, font_color = {1,1,1,1},
        click_function = "setCleanView", function_owner = self
    })
end

function nop(obj, player_clicker_color)
    -- nonfunctional label button
end

local function readTint(tint)
    local r = tint.r or tint[1] or 1
    local g = tint.g or tint[2] or 1
    local b = tint.b or tint[3] or 1
    local a = tint.a or tint[4] or 1
    return r, g, b, a
end

function setPlanetView(obj, player_clicker_color)
    local tint = (self.getColorTint and self.getColorTint()) or {r=1,g=1,b=1,a=1}
    local r,g,b = readTint(tint)
    self.setColorTint({r=r, g=g, b=b, a=0})
    local url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10879276274763555337/53E523522A70C64A2C73416058FFFBE0FC20B79F/"
    if Backgrounds and Backgrounds.setCustomURL then
        Backgrounds.setCustomURL(url)
    else
        print("Cannot set background to Planet View")
    end
end

function setCleanView(obj, player_clicker_color)
    local tint = (self.getColorTint and self.getColorTint()) or {r=1,g=1,b=1,a=1}
    local r,g,b = readTint(tint)
    self.setColorTint({r=r, g=g, b=b, a=1})
    local url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10595199214098029133/204F1FE5FFB225D2621AB2E1B6142831A6C5CE21/"
    if Backgrounds and Backgrounds.setCustomURL then
        Backgrounds.setCustomURL(url)
    else
        print("Cannot set background to Clean View")
    end
end

--[[
    Mat Chooser Script
    
    This mat tile uses Global UI for the mat chooser panel.
    This approach ensures the UI persists even when the mat reloads.
    
    Flow:
    1. Player clicks "Choose Mat Image" button on the mat
    2. Mat tells Global to open the UI, passing its GUID
    3. Player selects an image in the Global UI
    4. Global calls back to this mat's changeMatImage() function
    5. Mat changes its image and reloads (UI is unaffected because it's Global)
]]

function onLoad()
    self.interactable = true
    self.gizmo_selectable = false

    -- Create the "Choose Mat Image" button on the object
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "openChooser",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Choose Mat Image",
        position       = {-0.8, 0.2, -1.05},
        rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
        width          = 2000,
        height         = 500,
        scale          = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1},
        font_size      = 250,
        color          = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    })
end

-- Called when the button is clicked - opens Global UI
function openChooser(obj, playerColor, alt_click)
    -- Tell Global to open the mat chooser UI for this player
    -- We pass our GUID so Global can find us later when the player selects an image
    Global.call("openMatChooser", {
        playerColor = playerColor,
        matGUID = self.getGUID()
    })
end

-- Called by Global when the player selects a mat image
function changeMatImage(params)
    local url = params.url
    if not url then return end
    
    -- Change the custom object image
    local custom = self.getCustomObject()
    custom.image = url
    self.setCustomObject(custom)
    
    -- Reload to apply the new image
    -- The UI is in Global, so it won't be affected by this reload!
    self.reload()
end
